messages.subject: Executive application | Manufacturing, ESG and country stakeholder leadership
messages.body:
Dear SVI Recruitment Team,

I am submitting my executive profile through SVI’s published Thailand careers channel after my earlier note to Investor Relations was rejected by my email provider before delivery.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities cover government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate coordination, strategic partnerships and executive stakeholder strategy across a major industrial operation.

SVI’s international electronics manufacturing platform aligns well with my experience coordinating regulators, public institutions, communities, contractors and internal teams around complex operating and sustainability priorities. My recent work also includes stakeholder governance around large-scale solar and battery infrastructure, carbon-data readiness and executive issue management.

I would welcome consideration for Thailand or regional mandates across Corporate Affairs, Government Relations, Sustainability, ESG, Strategic Partnerships or Country Leadership. I am internationally mobile and available following a 30-day notice period.

My attached CV is tailored to SVI. I would value a confidential discussion with the relevant senior HR or business leader.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
